title: EventBus self-unregister and self-register during emit contract

contract.emit_snapshot: Self-unregister and self-register operations during an active emit do not alter the current delivery snapshot
contract.current_emit_isolation: A self-re-registered listener is not invoked twice during the same emit
contract.subsequent_delivery: A self-re-registered listener participates in subsequent emits
contract.registry_order: The removed listener is appended when re-registered, preserving deterministic registry order
contract.duplicate_registration: Repeated registration of the same plugin and callback does not create duplicate registry entries
contract.mutation_safety: Combined self-removal and self-registration does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.source_integrity: Source payloads remain unchanged after emit and listener mutation
